title: Dzonot Zebra, Chemuyil - Czech Speleological Society 2005
credits: Explored and surveyed 2005 by R. Husák, D. Hutňan, M. Megela, Z. Motyčka; drawn by Zdeněk Motyčka, Daniel Hutňan; digitised by Pavla Hazmuková. Czech Speleological Society. Length 1,819 m
placementWhy: Weak placement: scale from the 100 m bar (0.0856 m/px; the 'Dzonot Zebra, Tulum' version of the same survey gives the same size), north up (the arrow is magnetic north 2004, about 1-2 degrees off true: ignored, a few metres at the map's far end), shifted onto one point: Dzonot Werich's pool put on the only opening in the canopy near the database's Werich - a rocky clearing about 25 m across, 73 m NNW of it. The two database positions (Gerrard 2015, not taken on site) cannot both be right: they are 517 m apart, Zebra NNE of Werich, where the map has Zebra 185 m ESE of Werich; with Werich on the clearing, the database's Zebra is 512 m off (it sits by a grassy clearing with a dark hole at its west end, 22 m south of it - another cenote?). Nothing else to check against: closed forest, no OSM road or water, no already placed map overlaps (K'oox Baal's walls end about 500 m south, Shoot's Hool is 350 m south-west). Uncertainty: tens of metres at best; a GPS fix of either cenote on site would settle it.

symbols.why: No legend, and nothing written in the plan but the two cenote names: no depths (no overlined/underlined numbers - checked tile by tile), no restriction or silt letters, no bones (no icon, no text), no flow arrows, no leads written (the passage ends are dashed walls, drawn as details). The small arrows on the walls are cross-section marks. OCR reads four boulders' '//' marks as circled numbers (7, 77, 7, 4): dropped (fix).

unverified: placed on a guessed canopy clearing as Werich; no cenote of the map has a reliable position (both database ones are from Gerrard and disagree with the map by 500 m)
